## Resume Building Tips


Applying for jobs can be daunting. Job hunting typically comes with more rejection than expected. So how do you stand out? What do you include and what do you leave out of your resume to get the interview?


Larry Pitchford, Chief Human Resources Officer at VNB, says to keep it simple and to absolutely do this one thing to get the extra look. Find out more in our latest podcast episode.
